name: ProtectedViewWindows
description: A collection of the ProtectedViewWindow objects that represent all the Protected View windows that are currently open in the application.
remarks: Use the ProtectedViewWindows property of the Application object to return the ProtectedViewWindows collection.
example:
MsgBox "There are " & ProtectedViewWindows.Count & _
 " Protected View windows currently open."

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

methods.name: Open
methods.signature: Open(Filename As String, [Password As Variant], [AddToMru As Variant], [RepairMode As Variant]) As ProtectedViewWindow
methods.description: Opens the specified workbook in a new Protected View window.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The name of the workbook (paths are accepted).

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password for opening the workbook.

parameters.name: AddToMru
parameters.description: True to add the file name to the list of recently used files on the Recent tab of the Backstage view.

parameters.name: RepairMode
parameters.description: True to repair the workbook to prevent file corruption.
